title: 新中式饮品战争④收官：9块9 和 30块，谁赢了 | China's Drink Wars P4 ☕
description:
这场饮品战，你站 9 块 9，还是 30 块？评论区站队。

【新中式饮品战争·收官集】一杯现磨咖啡能便宜到几块？9.9 元。2023 年两大品牌掀起价格战，一路卷到今天：9 块 9 拼命抢客，30 块死守品质。低价确实拉来了上亿用户，但利润也被打得很薄；后来一个走向涨价，一个死磕 9.9。从奶茶、到酸奶、再到咖啡——这四集看下来，你会发现新中式饮品的战争，本质都是同一场：便宜，还是值得。

How cheap can a fresh-brewed coffee get? 9.9 yuan. In 2023 two chains lit a price war that still burns: 9.9 grabs the crowds, 30 defends quality. Cheap really did pull in tens of millions of users — but it squeezed profits thin, and later one chain raised prices while the other held the line at 9.9. From milk tea to yogurt to coffee, all four episodes point to one war: cheap, or worth it.

AI-assisted edit; bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Neutral market observation, not investment advice; figures are 2023 Q3 public filings and the landscape keeps shifting. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
